Full-time · Remote · $400-600/mo

Job description

Commercial GRP acquires and manages office and industrial properties across the Midwest. Our analysts support every stage of a deal, from first look to closing, and work directly with the acquisitions team.

Responsibilities

  • Build underwriting models in Excel for new acquisitions
  • Research comparable sales and market rents
  • Prepare investment memos and PowerPoint decks for the investment committee

Qualifications

  • Pursuing a degree in finance, economics or real estate
  • Strong financial modeling and communication skills
